title: FLA import: CPicText colorEffect always null — decode tinted text fields
description:
In packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts, readCPicText() unconditionally returns colorEffect: null with a TODO comment (around lines 2399-2419). Text fields with Alpha/Tint/Brightness effects import as opaque/uncolored.

The fix: decode the color-effect block for text fields at ts >= 0x0D (Flash 8 schema 13). Look at how readCPicSymbolFields() at line 1862 reads the 24-byte color-effect block (schema >= 4). Apply the same read pattern in readCPicText() at the correct byte position (after instanceName/accessibility fields, before filter block — same layout as CPicSymbol).

Steps:
1. Read readCPicSymbolFields() to understand the exact 24-byte colorEffect block structure (it reads: a UI8 type byte, then type-specific fields totaling 24 bytes).
2. Find the correct byte position in readCPicText() — look at the existing skip/read calls around lines 2336-2419 to understand the field layout. The colorEffect read should go in the same relative position as in CPicSymbol (after instanceName and accessibility data, before filters).
3. Replace the hardcoded colorEffect: null with the decoded value.
4. Forward it through flash8-import.ts convertTextObject() to the model.

Run tests after: pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run AND pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run
Commit: fix(fla-import): decode CPicText colorEffect block for tinted text fields
